     DATE:      July 28, 1987

     SUBJECT:    BUILDING NOTICE AND ALTERATION APPLICATIONS



     This notice supersedes Directive 19 of 1971 and the
     November 24, 1972 Memorandum issued as a supplement to that
     Directive.
     Any application which requires a new or amended Certificate of
     Occupancy as determined by Section 27-213 through Section 27-224
     (C26-212.0) of the Building Code, shall be filed as an Alteration
     Application.
     Any application which does not require a new or amended Certi-
     ficate of Occupancy may be filed as a Building Notice.

 r As a reminder Section 27-215 (C26-121.3) requires a new Certi-

44 ficate of Occupancy for the following alteration:

             1. A change from one Occupancy Group (Section 27-237
                 (C26-301.1)) to another,




                                                  1
          2.   Where the existing means of egress is being
               affected by design, location, size, number or
               occupant load,

          3.   Increase of habitable rooms,
                                                      1
          4. A building with no existing Certificate of
             Occupancy.

However, as per Section 27-217 (C26-121.5) a new Certi-i
ficate of Occupancy shall not be required for just the change
of a zoning use if that use remains within the same Use Group
as listed in the Zoning Resolution.

All existing Department Directives and Memorandums requiring
new Certificate of Occupancy remain in effect.

The Borough Superintendent may require a new Certificate of
Occupancy when there is any change from an existing Certificate
of Occupancy.
